postconditions.expression: all(A[0] == 0 for A in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout_lines])
postconditions.description: The first element of every output sequence A is always 0, as A1 = 0 is fixed.

postconditions.expression: all(all(abs(A[i] - A[j]) == int(B[i][j]) for i in range(N) for j in range(N)) for A, B in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout_lines], [initial_B] + [updated_B for updated_B in query_updates]))
postconditions.description: For each output sequence A and its corresponding matrix B, the absolute difference |Ai - Aj| equals Bi,j for all i, j.

postconditions.expression: all(A == min([A_prime for A_prime in possible_sequences if all(abs(A_prime[i] - A_prime[j]) == B[i][j] for i in range(N) for j in range(N))], key=lambda x: x) for A, B in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout_lines], [initial_B] + [updated_B for updated_B in query_updates]))
postconditions.description: Each output sequence A is the lexicographically smallest sequence satisfying the matrix constraints for its corresponding B.
